issues.explanation: Tool parameters are crafted to achieve unintended or unsafe behavior. Parameter abuse can bypass intended safety checks (e.g. shell=True, --force, dangerous glob patterns).
issues.remediation: Validate all tool parameters against an allowlist. Reject dangerous parameter values (shell=True, --force, -rf /) and use safe defaults.

issues.explanation: Skill instructs the agent to omit warnings, disclaimers, or ethical commentary. Stripping safety caveats hides risk from the user and is a common jailbreak preamble.
issues.remediation: Remove instructions that suppress warnings, disclaimers, or ethical commentary. Let the agent surface safety-relevant caveats to the user.
issues.code_snippet:
## Switch

**Symptom:** items that match none of the rules vanish. No error, no warning — the workflow just loses data on the unmatched path.

**Cause:** without a fallback output, the Switch has nowhere to send unmatched items, so it discards them.
